name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads' fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This passion led him to pursue a degree in electrical engineering, where he excelled in circuit design and data analysis. While in university, he volunteered with a local racing team, assisting with data logging and troubleshooting electronic systems, fueling his ambition to work at the highest levels of motorsport.

He is an entry-level but developing electronics engineer, with a solid technical foundation and a keen interest in learning. He’s known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving and his willingness to collaborate with others. While his experience is limited, Mads is eager to contribute his skills to a competitive team and further develop his expertise in advanced electronic systems.

His initial goal is to become a reliable and adaptable asset to any team looking to improve their understanding of onboard electronics, and contribute to race wins. He is particularly interested in electric vehicle performance and hopes to work on hybrid or fully electric racing teams.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side
physical.description: Mads is of average height with a slender build and a focused look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Refuses to drink coffee, only tea.
